# Sovra

Sovra is a privacy-first AI second brain for iPhone and iPad. It triages Gmail, Apple Mail, and IMAP email into notes, tasks, and calendar events using on-device AI — your data never leaves your device.

## About

Sovra is made by Nammu Technologies. It is available exclusively on iOS (iPhone and iPad) via the App Store. Core values: on-device AI processing, zero-knowledge encrypted sync, zero inbox, data sovereignty.
